name: Southeast Slopes from North Glacier Pass

text.description: Walk to Thousand Island Lake and North Glacier Pass, then up easy slopes. The hard part is picking the true summit among bumps.

name: Southeast Ridge from Black Rock Pass

text.description: Cross Glacier Pass and descend toward Cliff Creek, climb to Black Rock Pass, then traverse the ridge to the saddle at the base of the southeast ridge. Follow the ridge to the summit; long and tedious rather than hard.
A trail leads up from the Lakes Basin to the summit. Other access points also exist.

name: West Ridge from Lucys Foot Pass

text.description: Approach via the Bubbs Creek and East Lake drainage to Lake Reflection and the chute leading to Lucys Foot Pass, then scramble the west ridge to the summit. A multi-day trip with exposed, loose terrain near the top.
